blog.visible.label: Show this page to visitors
blog.visible.hint: Off, and the blog disappears from the menu and answers Not Found for everybody except you. Useful while it is still being written.

blog.meta.description.value: Expert insights, practical tips, and thought leadership on agile methodologies, team dynamics, and organizational transformation.
blog.meta.description.label: Search description
blog.meta.description.hint: The sentence Google shows under the page title in search results. Around 150 to 160 characters; longer is cut off mid-word.

blog.meta.titlePrefix.label: Browser tab and search result title
blog.meta.titlePrefix.hint: What comes before the business name in the browser tab and in a search result. The page name on its own is fine; something a person would search for is better.

blog.hero.heading.label: Hero heading
blog.hero.heading.hint: The teal hero above the post list

blog.hero.intro.value: Practical writing on delivery, coaching and ways of working.
blog.hero.intro.label: Hero introduction
blog.hero.intro.hint: The teal hero above the post list

blog.list.all.label: Every category
blog.list.all.hint: The first choice above the posts, which shows every post. Only shown when posts have categories

blog.list.noneInCategory.value: No posts in this category yet.
blog.list.noneInCategory.label: Empty category
blog.list.noneInCategory.hint: Shown when the chosen category has no posts

blog.list.empty.label: No posts yet
blog.list.empty.hint: Shown in place of the posts until the first one is published
